pages.text: Well, bless my ladle! A new face, and a sturdy one. Welcome to Skyhaven, {player}. I'm &6Hollis Barrowmead&r, and this is the &6Lantern & Ladle&r. Sit down, you look like you've travelled.

Skyhaven is a floating village, and it belongs to nobody and everybody. It's your &6home base&r: shops, masters who teach the trades, and a way down to the wild world below. You'll always come back here, so make yourself comfortable.
Now, what would you like to know, friend? I've the whole afternoon, and the stew's warming.

choices.label: What are the little ! and ? marks?

pages.text: Look around. Smiths and masters, a banker, a curio dealer with a shop full of oddities, even a florist. Right-click anyone to talk. Most will sell you something, and a few will give you work.

A &6gold !&r over someone means they have a job for you. A &6grey ?&r means you're still working on theirs. A &6gold ?&r means they're waiting for your report. Do the job, come back, and that's when you get paid.

Every trade is a &6skill&r: Mining, Farming, Foraging, Fishing and Combat. You gain XP by doing the work, and each level opens better tools and recipes. No classes, no choosing. Do all of it if you fancy.

Below the clouds lies the &6survival world&r, wide and wild. That's where the real work is: ore, trees, monsters, ruins. The way down is the &6Wildgate&r, on the south islet. Don't rush it. A few lessons first.
That's the whole of it, for now. Come see me whenever you like. Eat, rest, gossip. Here, a loaf for the road. And press &6K&r, would you? I've something to show you about it.
